module_title: Sarod, Santoor, and High-Frequency SSC Favorites
introduction: This level focuses on the instruments and maestros that are absolute favorites of SSC paper setters. If the paper is of moderate difficulty, the questions will come directly from here.

core_concepts.title: Sarod (Tata / String Instrument)
core_concepts.description:
Exponents: **Ustad Amjad Ali Khan**, Ustad Ali Akbar Khan, Ustad Allauddin Khan. 
Key Fact: The Sarod looks somewhat like a Sitar but has a metal fingerboard with NO frets (metal ridges). Amjad Ali Khan's sons, Amaan and Ayaan Ali Bangash, are also famous Sarod players.

core_concepts.title: Santoor (Tata / String Instrument)
core_concepts.description:
Exponents: **Pt. Shivkumar Sharma**, **Bhajan Sopori**.
Key Fact: Santoor is originally a traditional folk instrument from Jammu & Kashmir. It has 100 strings and is played using a pair of light wooden mallets.

core_concepts.title: Sarangi (Tata / String Instrument)
core_concepts.description:
Exponents: **Pt. Ram Narayan**, Ustad Shakoor Khan, Ustad Sultan Khan.
Key Fact: Sarangi is considered one of the most difficult Indian instruments to master, as it is played with the cuticles (skin above the nails) rather than the fingertips.

core_concepts.title: Violin (Tata / String Instrument)
core_concepts.description:
Exponents: **Dr. L. Subramaniam**, T.N. Krishnan, N. Rajam.
Key Fact: Though Western in origin, the violin was seamlessly adapted into Indian Classical Music, especially Carnatic (South Indian) music.

important_entities.name: Ustad Allauddin Khan
important_entities.significance: He was a legendary Sarod player and the guru (teacher) of greats like Pt. Ravi Shankar (Sitar) and Pt. Pannalal Ghosh (Flute).

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation:
Exam Trap: These two legends often composed film music together under the name 'Shiv-Hari' (e.g., for the movie Silsila). 
Do not mix their instruments: 
- Shivkumar Sharma = **Santoor**.
- Hariprasad Chaurasia = **Flute**.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Santoor translates to '100 strings'. Both 'Shiv'kumar Sharma and 'Bhajan' Sopori (singing bhajans for Shiva) are associated with the Santoor.

exam_strategy_tips: A patent SSC CGL question: 'Pandit Shivkumar Sharma is associated with which musical instrument?' Answer: Santoor.
